opportunities.point: The company aims to increase the revenue contribution from manufacturing from 23% to 50% over the next two to three years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Currently, 23% of our revenue comes from the manufacturing capabilities, but in the next two to three years, we want to scale the manufacturing contribution to turnover to 50%, with overall increase in turnover also." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company is working to improve EBITDA margins by strengthening manufacturing capabilities and building economies of scale.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "EBITDA margins, we are working to improve because we are trying to strengthen our manufacturing capabilities." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company acquired 9.6 acres of land to build a polymer additives and compounding facility.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "First of all, this 9.6 acre land which we have taken is for developing our polymer additives and polymer compound facility, whereas specified that in next 12 to 18 months, we will be taking our manufacturing capabilities to 18,000 metric tons." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company recently set up a polymer additives plant with a capacity of 400 metric tons per month.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Raw material demand rose sharply from December onwards, with prices increasing significantly in February.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "So, we have sourced the material for next six months or suddenly there was demand from December onwards of these raw materials and the prices have increased tremendously in February of these raw materials." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: SK Minerals is focusing its flame-retardant products on the cable and wire and electrical equipment industries.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "This flame-retardant is being used in various industries, but currently, we are focusing on cable and wire and electrical and electronics equipment." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: SK Minerals currently maintains an order book of approximately Rs. 55 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Currently, order book is around about Rs. 55 crore and it depends upon the customer." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Government customers account for Rs. 42 crores of the total Rs. 55 crore order book.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Out of these Rs. 55 crores, Rs. 42 crores is from government and rest is from private." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to file three patents in the next six months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "But in next six months, we will try to file three patents." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company's working capital cycle stands at 110 days.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "Currently, working capital cycle is of 110 days." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 11 -> 18 Cr (Mar 2026) but operating cash flow -3 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -75 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: Borrowings above equity leave limited room if the cycle turns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -1.85 pp, DII -7.2 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Geopolitical issues have impacted import trading inventory as available stock gets depleted.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In terms of the import trading, yes, it has impacted because we have three months’ stock always available with us." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The new polymer additives plant is experiencing initial teething problems during trials.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Entry into polymer additives involves technical, technological, and R&D barriers.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In terms of barrier, there are technical and technological barriers. There are R&D barriers." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

swot.verdict: No quadrant dominates - strengths, opportunities carry equal weight (S28/W23/O28/T20), so the evidence does not favour one side.
